summary: Accomplished Mobile Application Architect and Lead Software Development Engineer currently with Guardian, bringing over a decade of progressive industry experience architecting scalable Android, iOS, IoT, and enterprise mobility platforms. Proven track record leading mobile engineering initiatives at Guardian, Ayla Networks, and Vectone Mobile, delivering high-throughput enterprise applications, real-time communication systems (VoIP, WebRTC, WebSockets), and modular architectures. Deep expertise in Clean Architecture, MVI/MVVM, on-device AI/ML (TensorFlow, OpenCV), and reactive streams.

projects_and_responsibilities: Architecting and engineering mission-critical enterprise mobile platforms at Guardian.
Driving mobile architectural standards, Clean Architecture, modularization, and modern Kotlin/Jetpack Compose and iOS practices.
Leading security, compliance, performance optimization, and cross-functional engineering pods across distributed enterprise systems.

Built real-time messaging, audio/video conferencing, and location telemetry modules utilizing WebRTC, Socket.IO, and XMPP protocols.
